summary.motive: Punish aggressive backside defensive ends and pursuit defenders who crash down the line against wide zone runs.
summary.whyItWorks: Wide zone forces the entire defense to sprint laterally in one direction; pulling the ball and booting opposite creates a numbers advantage with no pass rushers in front of the QB.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined backside DE staying home in contain and hitting the quarterback as soon as he turns around on the bootleg.

beats.title: 1. Full Wide Zone Flow Left
beats.text: Offensive line and running back sprint on outside zone left tracks. The defense shifts its entire momentum to the left sideline.

beats.title: 2. The Backside DE Crashes Inside
beats.text: Strongside DE (backside contain) bites inside on the run mesh, leaving the entire right flank completely unprotected.

beats.title: 3. QB Naked Rollout & Triangle Flood
beats.text: The QB pulls the ball and sprints into open space. TE slips into the flat (short), X crosses on a drag (intermediate), and Z clears the corner (deep).

beats.title: 4. Pitch-and-Catch in the Flat
beats.text: With the defense completely out of position on the opposite hash, QB delivers an easy completion to the TE for a 15+ yard walk-in gain.

relations.tell: QB pulls the ball out of the mesh and rolls right away from the offensive line flow, while TE releases into the backside flat.
